title.zh: Recursive豪华创始团首次交卷：让AI参与造AI，4个月练出40B模型
title.en: Recursive豪华创始团首次交卷：让AI参与造AI，4个月练出40B模型

current_state.zh: AI startup Recursive released Flint, a ~40B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts coding-agent model with Apache 2.0 open weights that scores 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified and was developed in under four months with the help of its automated 'Eureka Machine' research system.
